metadata.description: SunflowersLwtech's toolbox: Claude Code skills, agents, commands, and MCP servers in one marketplace.

plugins.name: polanyi-design
plugins.description: Frontend design cognitive engine grounded in Michael Polanyi's tacit knowledge framework. Surfaces expert-level visual judgment in UI design, component architecture, and design systems.

plugins.name: loopify-requirements
plugins.description: Convert prompts, vague tasks, and agent workflows into repeatable, verifiable loops with goal/scope/verification/escalation/stop conditions.

plugins.name: github-repo-to-x-threads
plugins.description: Analyze technical sources and produce Agent-engineering-positioned X content packs with evidence review, quality chain, reusable assets, and image assets.

plugins.name: searchpo
plugins.description: OSS Radar search pipeline: data prep, agent harness, research/impl agents, and the searchpo-full-flow command.

plugins.name: mcp-creator-growth
plugins.description: Context-aware learning sidebar for AI coding assistants, served as an MCP server (Python, runs via uvx). Lives in its own repository.

plugins.name: search-harness
plugins.description: Domain knowledge and roadmap for building a search harness for coding agents: CLI + skills design notes, API docs, and strategy.

plugins.name: mesh
plugins.description: list_agents / send_message across Claude Code sessions on other accounts and machines, via a self-hosted relay and a channel. Start sessions with --channels plugin:mesh@sunkit.

plugins.name: archify
plugins.description: tt-a1i/archify v3.1 pinned to a reviewed commit: typed JSON IR rendered as interactive standalone HTML diagrams (architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow and more), checked in headless Chrome. Installs disabled; the show-me skill reads its SKILL.md by path.

plugins.name: frontier
plugins.description: Subagents that hand a task to Antigravity (two accounts), OpenCode Zen's free models, ZCode, or any model on the magpie gateway, each in its own official client.
